about_the_game:
Demonbyte is a brutal, over-the-top boomer shooter that throws you into a pixelated hellscape of demons, chaos, and relentless action. Inspired by classic's from the 90's, this is pure FPS mayhem with a futuristic twist.

🔫 First-Person Carnage

Step into the boots of a lone space marine fighting off a demonic invasion powered by corrupted sci-fi tech. Armed with an arsenal of wild and ridiculous weapons — from futuristic swords, classic assault rifles to the now-infamous husky puppy handguns — every pull of the trigger brings satisfying destruction.

🧠 Kill, Seek, Repeat

Slay demons, Find hidden secrets! Each level is packed with loot, secrets, and funny dialog to fuel your rampage. Build your loadout to suit your playstyle: go loud, go weird, or go wild.

🌌 Aesthetic Violence

Featuring slick pixel art with a modern twist, Demonbyte blends old-school visuals with stylized effects and chaotic energy. Each level drips with atmosphere — industrial wastelands, techno-temples, and glitch-ridden voids.

💀 Key Features:

  • Fast-paced, first-person combat inspired by retro classics

  • Tons of secrects and variety of weapons, including sci-fi melee tools and absurd firearms

  • Hand-crafted pixel art levels filled with secrets, traps, and enemy swarms

  • A signature sense of humor (Yes, that handgun really does look like a husky puppy.)

  • Original soundtrack to keep your adrenaline pumping

🚫 What This Game Is Not:

This isn’t a cover shooter. There’s no hiding here. Demonbyte is about constant movement, skillful aim, and absolute chaos. If you stop moving, you die.

(although u can always try to hide) 😉

Whether you're a retro FPS veteran or a new player looking for stylish destruction, Demonbyte delivers pure demon-slaying, loot-grabbing, gun-blazing fun.

Kill. Seek. Repeat. Welcome to the byte.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent blood, gore, and graphic depictions of death, including dismemberment and intense combat scenarios. There are also elements of fear, such as disturbing enemy designs and unsettling environments.

Additionally, Demonbyte features strong language and heavy use of profanity, including dark humor and parody-based dialogue that is often spoken directly to the player. Some content may be considered offensive or inappropriate for younger audiences.

Player discretion is advised.
